# Week 1: Aug 26--28

**Required Reading**

* Ch 1: Sec 1.1 p. 1-6, Sec 1.2-1.3 p. 6-13

#### _Wednesday_

* Introductions to the course and each other  
* Motivation for generalized linear models

#### _Friday_ 

* Introduction to generalized linear models in the context of the data analysis process

---

# Week 2: Aug 31--Sep 4

**Required Reading**

* Ch 2: Sec 2.1 p. 26-33, Sec 2.2.1-2.2.3 p. 33-37, Sec 2.3.1-2.3.2 p. 41-45, Sec 2.4.1 p. 49-50, Sec 2.7 p. 67-70
* Ch 3: Sec 3.3.1 p. 95-96


#### _Monday_

* Interpreting regression coefficients, linear models theory and ordinary least squares

#### _Wednesday_

* Linear models theory and OLS (cont)

#### _Friday_

* Linear models theory and OLS (cont), weighted least squares

---

# Week 3: Sep 7--11

**Required Reading**

* Ch 4: Sec 4.1 p. 120-123

#### _Monday_

* _No classes: Labor Day_

#### _Wednesday_

* Adjustment variables, smoking and lung capacity case study on slides

#### _Friday_

* GLM components, exponential dispersion family and properties

---

# Week 4: Sep 14--18

**Required Reading**

* Ch 4: Sec 4.2.1-4.2.4 p. 123-127, Sec 4.5 p. 138-143
* Ch 4: Sec 4.3 p. 128-132, Sec 4.4 p. 132-138

#### _Monday_

* Likelihood and asymptotics for GLMs, algorithms for fitting GLM models (Newton-Raphson, Fisher scores, IWLS)

#### _Wednesday_

* Newton-Raphson and Fisher scoring (cont)

#### _Friday_

* Wald and score tests, deviance, residuals for GLMs

---

# Week 5: Sep 21--25

**Required Reading**

* Ch 5 Sec 5.1 p. 165-168, Sec 5.6 p. 183-186

#### _Monday_

* Models for binary data

#### _Wednesday_

* Logistic regression interpretations, odds ratio versus relative risk in case-control studies

#### _Friday_

* Logistic regression (cont) (Dr. Mark Greenwood)

---

# Week 6: Sep 28--Oct 2

**Required Reading**

* Ch 5 Sec 5.2.4 p. 170-172, Sec 5.4 p. 176-179, Sec 5.5 p. 179-183

#### _Monday_

* Summarizing predictive power, Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness of fit for binary data, diagnostics for binary data, model fitting in logistic regression and complete separation (Dr. Mark Greenwood)

#### _Wednesday_

* Catch up and review

#### _Friday_

* Attend the Montana ASA Chapter Meeting in Wilson Hall 001 instead of class. Register and view the schedule here: <https://shinjini8.github.io/mt-asa-meeting-2026/>
